title: Erdős Problem 656: translated restricted pair sums
summary: A reproduction of a complete Lean proof that every set A of natural numbers with positive ordinary upper asymptotic density contains an infinite subset B whose distinct pair sums, after one integer translation, all lie in A. This is the exact ordinary-density statement of Erdős Problem 656, an instance of Kra–Moreira–Richter–Robertson Theorem 1.2(i).

formalizes.title: A proof of Erdős's B+B+t conjecture

review.reason: Lean reproduction of a proof for Erdős Problem 656 on translated restricted pair sums.
